BAYFRONT REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER - EMERGENCY MEDICINE / COMMUNITY OUTREACH CARE COORDINATION NOTE WHITLOCK, MARCUS D MRN 0044718 DOB 06/09/2049 Date: 03/03/2088 Location of visit: domiciliary, bed B-17
Dictated but not read.
This is a dictation regarding Mr Whitlock, a 38 year old divorced gentleman who has been without stable housing since January 2088 and who is currently residing at the Harbor Light Domiciliary, 900 Dockside Ave, Baltimore, Maryland 21230. I saw him on the ward round at the domiciliary, this being the second of his monthly visits following the visit on 2 February, and I am writing up the picture so that the emergency department, the outreach team and the shelter staff all have the same understanding because he uses our department as his front door when he is in pain. He has chronic low back pain since September 2079 and takes a hydrocodone and acetaminophen tablet, 300 milligrams of acetaminophen, under an agreement number OA-88-0412 with a single prescriber; the pharmacy is on file. He has prediabetes with the last hemoglobin A one C of five point eight and a mild anemia which we are watching. Blood pressure today was one twenty-eight over seventy.
Social. He lost his full time job at Cobbler's Row Auto Parts some years ago, part time work ended in December 2084, and the episode of violence in his previous neighbourhood is on the problem list. His ex wife Sheree Whitlock is not to be contacted. His daughter Nia is 17 and lives with her mother. His sister Danielle Whitlock-Greer is the family contact, number 410-555-0166. He has made a friend at the domiciliary, Mrs Ottoline Pratt, who is ninety-three and whom he helps up the stairs; he asked that she be listed as emergency contact, which I explained I could not do, but I have noted it. Scratch that, I have listed her as a visitor. Colleen at social work will chase the housing application.
"VOLUNTEER NOTES" (Tyrell Banks, MA, summer program) - pt was super chill today, vibes good but tired - he smells of smoke. he said he is trying to cut down - Mrs Pratt (93 yo) gave me a cookie lol In conclusion Mr. Whitlock's journey is a story of resilience.
Plan: continue present medication, return in one month, housing application with Colleen Nakagawa-Ruiz, LCSW, ext x4482. cc: Bayfront Regional Medical Center outreach file Electronically signed by Reuben Ashgrove-Mensah, MD on 03/03/2088 16:55
